description: One holiday rental: what it is, where (rounded when the host keeps the address private), capacity, amenities (fixed ids + labels), house rules, check-in/out times, cancellation policy (`cancellation.terms` is what the level promises; for `custom` read `note`), photos and a from-price per night. `bookable: false` means the page shows the place but takes no online booking – the guest contacts the host; do not quote or prepare a checkout for it. `bookingMode` says what happens after the guest presses book: `request` (host confirms), `request_hold` (card held, host confirms) or `instant`.

slug.description: The place's slug – the last part of its page URL (posadita.com/p/{slug}), or from search_stays or /llms.txt.

name: get_property
